name: PAM8403 stereo amplifier module
source: Diodes Incorporated PAM8403 datasheet DS36439 Rev. 2-3
description: 5V filterless class-D stereo amplifier module represented by its common breakout terminals
firmware: Arduino core dacWrite on ESP32 GPIO25 and GPIO26
requirements: Use 5V power and a shared ESP32 ground
Drive LIN and RIN from ESP32 DAC-capable GPIO25 and GPIO26
Each bridge-tied speaker connects across one matching OUT+ and OUT- pair; never ground a speaker output
